M. R. James, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/m-r-james/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- M. R. James, the annotator and author, died 1936.

First publication of the text used: 1904 to 1925 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories published between 1904 and 1925 by M. R. James.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1904 to 1925, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement below says it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths (last death: 1936), so the text is public domain in each of them. The facts point to none of France, Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Russia or the USSR.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
